EGG native decoder core

Probability models, arithmetic decoder and tables ported to C++ from:
https://github.com/akolman/EggDotNet/tree/78b64f54026a8687dac1cdd4c86eb5fe5abf04ae/src/EggDotNet/Compression/AZO
Commit: 78b64f54026a8687dac1cdd4c86eb5fe5abf04ae
License: MIT; original notice retained in LICENSE.EggDotNet.txt.
Exact reference sources and per-file hashes:
tests/fixtures/archives/egg/EggDotNet-reference-source.tar.gz and manifest.json

LEA round/key-schedule parameters and EGG encryption framing also follow the
same pinned MIT source in src/EggDotNet/Encryption/Lea/Imp/LeaCryptoTransform.cs
and Format/Egg/EncryptHeader.cs. AES/PBKDF2/HMAC use Windows CNG; ZipCrypto and
stream framing are implemented directly by One. Native code uses exact two-byte
password verification, independent ciphertext authentication and continuous
cipher state across all blocks in a file. It does not copy the reference's
AES128 verifier collision or short LEA stream bug (see the fixture README).
An Encrypt Info field before a File Header belongs only to that following
entry, matching the reference's fresh-entry parsing; it is not inherited by
later files. Prefix headers between completed files are handled with the same
scope. The separate, unused Global Encrypt signature is not enabled.

One changes: C++ port with exact-read/write callbacks, bounded zero padding,
strict sizes/indices/match distances, memory accounting before allocation and
cancellation checkpoints. AZO framing has no checksum; the enclosing EGG reader
must check each decoded block's CRC, size and complete packed consumption.
egg-codecs.cpp now performs those checks for Store/Deflate/BZip2/AZO/LZMA and
provides bounded custom allocation for zlib/BZip2/liblzma. Cipher authentication
is finalized separately after all blocks of the file.

Per-block x86 address filter follows the CC0 1.0 descriptive pseudocode A.12:
https://github.com/alkegi/docs/blob/36230c34d3056604cc63519e9855a79e894496b7/egg.md
Git blob: 748a5940cc4e07f03867bb1dc09da86e586ed367
This document is only a secondary description. Parent-path semantics and the
private-version constant disagree with real files/reference code elsewhere;
One validates actual fixtures rather than trusting those descriptions.

These core modules are tested independently. They do not by themselves add an
EGG product entry point. The test-only .NET oracle is not a runtime dependency.
